title: image
description: An image of the data file's directory, such as a screenshot, shown in the page as a data URI: a png, jpeg, gif, webp or svg file up to 1 MiB, with a caption under it if written. One drawn smaller than its size zooms as a diagram does

file.description: The path of the image, relative to the data file's directory and under it

alt.description: What the image shows, for a screen reader and where it cannot be shown

caption.description: A line of Markdown under the image, saying what it shows to every reader, such as 図 1：…
